provenance.note: Fictional company written for harness validation. Not a real company; any resemblance is coincidental.

evidence.text: Sensorgrid Cloud is the device intelligence platform for connected hardware. Monitor millions of sensors, gateways and machines from one dashboard.

Sensorgrid does not sell or manufacture devices. Customers connect their existing sensors through our REST API or MQTT bridge, and all data is processed in Sensorgrid's multi-tenant cloud. There is no self-hosted edition.
Plans are billed monthly per connected device, starting at 500 devices.

summary.statement: Sensorgrid is a cloud-only software platform for monitoring customers' existing connected devices; it does not make hardware despite its hardware-centric wording.
summary.quote: Sensorgrid does not sell or manufacture devices

claims.statement: Billed monthly per connected device with a 500-device minimum.

cloud.quote: all data is processed in Sensorgrid's multi-tenant cloud

edge.rationale: Devices only send data to the cloud; no processing at the edge is described.

fit.rationale: The homepage talks about hardware, sensors and gateways, but Sensorgrid is pure multi-tenant cloud software with no self-hosted or edge component, so it has no need for Northwind's on-premises inference appliances.
